label: S&P 500 Trailing P/E (cap-weighted) + Forward P/E (12-month forward consensus, weekly)

source.method: Terminal data — 12-month blended-forward consensus P/E, weekly
source.perTicker: constituent trailing-twelve-month EPS, one snapshot per name
source.trailingSeed: long-run monthly S&P 500 P/E, back to 1871
source.forwardOwnMethod: Blended forward 12M: FY1/FY2 consensus net income weighted by published ETF holdings; one point per day. Agrees with the terminal blended-forward series to within 3% on all four universes (verified 2026-08-05).

note: Trailing PE is cap-weighted Σ(w·P)/Σ(w·trailingEps) computed from the 500 constituents daily, seeded with a long-run monthly series back to 1871. Forward PE is terminal data — 12-month blended-forward consensus estimates back to June 1990, published as one point per week (the last reading of each week). Alongside it we publish a second forward series computed daily from consensus estimates and published ETF holdings. The two are never blended: different estimate vintage, different weighting, different cadence. They agree to within 3%, and where they do not, the gap is the measurement and not an error to be smoothed away.
